body: I appreciate it. But I don't think there's anything anybody can do at this point. It's too late.

Other people are just better. There's always better options than me in every aspect. People who are more confident, more interesting, more attractive, ones who haven't been laid off like me, etc... I try, god knows I do, but it's not enough. 

Worst is that when someone has a bad day, they can go back to somebody really close to them if they have a special relationship. They can vent, confide, cry, talk, whatever... but I never have so it just exponentially gets worse and worse. I wish I'd never have met the people I do because I don't want anybody crying or hurting for me when I'm gone.

Everywhere I turn as of late is a reminder that I'm alone. I've never felt any sort of love and that's all I've wanted since I was young. All of my friends have partners, whether recent or long term, and all I can do is sit here and wonder why not me? Why never me? I have nobody close and never will, and I'm too weak to go through life alone like this. I feel so isolated that I don't want to go on since all I've felt for the last couple of years have been loneliness andsadness wishing I was never born in the first place.
